keywords: Criminal appeal – Murder and attempted murder – Sudden fight – Provocation – Deceased as aggressor – Bus altercation – Accused also injured – Self-defence evidence – Prosecution not calling other available witnesses – Murderous intention – Grave and sudden provocation/sudden fight – Request to reduce murder conviction to culpable homicide not amounting to murder – State conceding lesser culpability.
